name: mealtime
description: 每日吃什么 · 家庭点菜系统

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build:deploy: npm run build -w web && npm run bundle -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.test: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run test -w server" "npm run test -w web"
scripts.test:coverage: concurrently -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "npm run test:coverage -w server" "npm run test:coverage -w web"
